item.title: The Unholy Marriage of Tim Cook and Sam Altman: The Left’s ‘Monopolists’ Threatening America
item.description: America First Legal is calling out collusion between two leftist Big Tech titans that have used their companies to distort information and push a radical agenda.

item.title: Special Report: 183 to 6, Google News Suppresses Right-Leaning Outlets in March Iran War Coverage
item.description: Google News all but excluded right-leaning news outlets from coverage of the U.S.-Israel war with Iran, with 183 left-leaning stories to just six right-leaning ones. In March, war updates dominated Google News, with 239 stories highlighting the conflict in Iran and its proxies in neighboring countries. item.title: Google AI Gives Game Away: Leftist Gatekeeper ‘Consensus’ Controls Gemini’s Sources
item.description: EXCLUSIVE: Nearly three years ago, then–Vice President Kamala Harris openly revealed the left’s goal of controlling what information feeds AI to shape its outputs. Now, Google appears to have taken that playbook to heart, as its chatbot Gemini has disclosed that it effectively blocks right-leaning media from its systems.

item.title: Special Report: Microsoft MSN Doubles Down on Sidelining Right-Leaning Political Coverage
item.description: EXCLUSIVE: Last month, the Media Research Center exposed Microsoft’s MSN for manufacturing the illusion of balance on its feed while concealing its censorship by promoting non-political, right-leaning stories in top placements.

item.title: Special Report: 83% Left vs. 15% Right—Yahoo News Was Most Bipolar Big Four News App in March
item.description: A Media Research Center analysis found Yahoo News heavily favored left-leaning stories in March, with 400 of its top stories from the left and just 70 from the right, almost entirely Fox News. Yahoo virtually ignored center-rated outlets and was the most partisan of the Big Four news apps, highlighting a lack of balanced coverage for its large U.S. audience.

item.title: After Terror Threats, How Did Big Four News Apps Respond to Schumer’s DHS Shutdown? Erasure
item.description: EXCLUSIVE: The Big Four News Apps are controlling the political narrative to help Democrats, and it's working. Americans know that the U.S. is engaged in an armed conflict with Iran. Most are aware that there have been several suspected terrorist attacks on the homeland and that major American airports are facing hours-long security lines.

item.title: 87% Left-Leaning: Yahoo News Favors Left, Props Up Radical Sites in February
item.description: According to the MRC, Yahoo News is the most left-leaning of the Big Four News Apps, promoting articles from left-wing and radical outlets 87% of the time in February 2026, far more than its competitors. With massive online reach, this bias significantly influences American news and political narratives.

item.title: Tim Graham Exposes the Media’s 'Terrorist Sympathy' and Google News Bias on Fox Business
item.description: If you thought the elitist media couldn't sink any lower, think again. Tuesday morning on Fox Business' The Bottom Line, MRC NewsBusters Executive Editor Tim Graham joined Dagen McDowell and Brian Brenberg to dismantle a news cycle that has moved past bias and straight into delusion.

item.title: David Bozell Talks Big Tech Bias and Media's Anti-American Tilt
item.description: In a recent episode of the Will Cain Podcast, fill-in host Tim Young sat down with David Bozell, President of the Media Research Center (MRC), to discuss troubling patterns of media bias on the Big Four News apps and mainstream coverage of U.S. actions against Iran.

item.title: Big Four News Apps Use ZERO Right-Leaning Sources on Temple Israel Attack
item.description: The Big Four News Apps blacked out right-leaning outlets in their coverage of the Temple Israel attack in Michigan, an incident that threatened the safety of more than 100 students and Jewish individuals.

item.title: Microsoft's MSN &amp; Yahoo News Overlook Rape Allegations on Democrat ‘Icon’ Cesar Chavez to Push Clickbait
item.description: A day after a bombshell investigation implicated a far-left so-called civil rights icon in sex crime allegations, MSN and Yahoo News chose to promote ridiculous celebrity stories instead.

item.title: House Leadership Praises Much-Anticipated Trump AI Framework Released Today
item.description: The White House released its widely anticipated national framework for artificial intelligence on Friday, drawing the praise of House leadership, which has now pledged to enact the framework into legislation.

item.title: ‘Deceptive Trade’? MRC President Bozell Calls for Investigation of Apple News in Letter to FTC
item.description: Apple News’s bias against right-leaning media outlets has become more and more evident — and MRC studies suggest that this may be by design, prompting MRC President David Bozell to call for a federal investigation.

item.title: David Bozell on Fox Business Calls on Feds to Investigate Apple
item.description: Media Research Center (MRC) President David Bozell joined Fox Business Network’s Jackie DeAngelis and Brian Brengberg, hosts of The Bottom Line, on Friday, to talk about his letter to the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) requesting a formal investigation into Apple. Bozell said Apple News isn’t just curating news, it may be misleading consumers and shutting out competition in the process.

item.title: David Bozell On Morning Wire: News Apps Shape Public Opinion and are Hurting Trump in the Polls
item.description: The Big Four news apps, Apple News, Google News, MSN, and Yahoo News, are profoundly shaping public perception of two major crises: the ongoing Iran war and the prolonged Democrat-led defunding of the Department of Homeland Security (DHS).
